chunks: ʿAlī ibn Ibrāhīm, from Muḥammad ibn ʿĪsā, from Yūnus, from Sulaymān ibn Ṣāliḥ, raising it, from Abū Jaʿfar عليه السلام, who said:
Indeed, this hadith of yours causes the hearts of men to shrink in aversion from it. So whoever acknowledges it, then increase him in it; and whoever denies it, then leave him.

It is inevitable that there will be a tribulation in which every close insider and confidant will fall, until even the one who splits a hair with two hairs falls in it, until none remain except us and our Shiʿah.

key_terms.أَقَرَّ: affirmed, acknowledged, or accepted as true
key_terms.بِطَانَةٍ: an intimate insider or close associate
key_terms.تَشْمَئِزُّ: causes aversion or shrinking in disgust
key_terms.حَدِيثَكُمْ: your hadith; the teaching being conveyed to the followers
key_terms.شِيعَتُنَا: our Shiʿah; the devoted followers of the Ahl al-Bayt عليهم السلام
key_terms.فَتْنَةٌ: a trial or tribulation that tests people
key_terms.وَلِيجَةٍ: a close confidant or one admitted into inner affairs

ai.seo_question: How does Imam Abū Jaʿfar عليه السلام describe the trial that will separate true Shiʿah from others?
ai.summary: Imam Abū Jaʿfar عليه السلام states that this teaching is difficult for many people to accept, so it should be shared further only with those who affirm it. He foretells an unavoidable fitnah that will sift people severely, until only the Imam and his true Shiʿah remain steadfast.
